ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-14: Quote cannot be Accepted if there is a pending SBI (Billing Mode change not approved) or an exceeded Credit Limit not approved by Finance.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Accepted"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Rejected")), OR( AND( SBI_Flag__c, NOT(SBI_Finance_Approved__c) ), AND( Credit_Limit_Exceeded__c, NOT(Credit_Finance_Approved__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This quote cannot be accepted. Either a Billing Mode change (SBI) is pending Finance approval, or the Credit Limit has been exceeded and is pending Finance approval. Please ensure Finance has approved before accepting.
